claims.exact_statement: For F=q(x1,x2)h(y) with q any two-bit Boolean gate and h any disjoint Boolean core, every physical tree resolving x1,x2 satisfies R(T)<=Pi_I(T)=I(q), with terminal E U=U(h), E I=I(h). If h obeys GU(a,b), 0<=b<1, then F obeys GU(max(a,2-b),b).
claims.first_unproved_line: Replace disjoint tensor factorization by a shared-data collision estimate retaining signed Gamma and terminal U.
